title: Gothic Coastal Horror Coaster Bundle, Ghost Ship, Haunted Lighthouse, Hell Hound, Bats (Digital Download)
description:
A stormy, gothic quartet for coaster and sublimation projects: a spectral hell hound charging past ancient ruins, a cursed ghost pirate ship crashing through moonlit waves, a lonely haunted lighthouse standing against lightning, and a cave full of bats pouring out at blood-orange sunset.

✦ WHAT YOU GET
• 4 separate high-resolution PNG files (2400 x 2400 px, 300 DPI)
• Each design sold as one bundle, ready for sublimation coasters, UV DTF printing, tumblers, and more
• Instant digital download — no physical item is shipped

✦ DESIGN NOTES
Every scene in this set leans into moody, coastal gothic horror: fog, moonlight, and crashing surf tie the four pieces together as a cohesive collection for horror and dark-fantasy lovers.

✦ AI DISCLOSURE
These designs were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools as part of my creative process, then hand-curated, cleaned up, and prepared for print. This listing is a digital file only; no physical product is shipped.

✦ USAGE
For personal use and small-batch commercial use on physical items you make and sell (coasters, tumblers, apparel, etc.). Resale or redistribution of the digital files themselves is not permitted.

Thank you for shopping Dragon Oak Studio!
